readOnly.title: Hoard is read-only
readOnly.body: Hoard's records are kept as they are. You can read and export them.

errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Open Hoard again from Initiative.
errors.COMMUNITY_UNAVAILABLE: This community can't use Hoard right now.
errors.READ_ONLY: Hoard is read-only, so nothing can be changed.
errors.ADMIN_ONLY: Only the community's admins can do that.
errors.INITIATIVE_UNAVAILABLE: Initiative can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.LOT_ON_HOLD: That lot is on hold, so nothing can be drawn from it.
errors.LOT_REQUIRED: Name the lot of each line: its category records every lot.
errors.JOB_NOT_FOUND: That job isn't in Hoard any more: finished jobs are removed after a week.
errors.JOB_RESULT_NOT_FOUND: That file isn't ready yet, or it was removed after a week.
errors.JOB_STARTER_ONLY: Only the member who started this can download its file.
errors.AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL: That's less than Hoard can keep in the unit it's counted in.
errors.UNIT_NOT_CONVERTIBLE: That unit doesn't convert to the one it's counted in.
errors.TYPE_UNKNOWN: Pick one of the types of this kind of record.
errors.COSTS_HIDDEN: Only members who see costs can set them.
errors.COMMUNITY_PAGE_ADMIN_ONLY: Only the community's admins can open Hoard for the whole community. Choose an initiative instead.
errors.CROSS_SITE_REQUEST: That request didn't come from Hoard's own pages.
